result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and row-house frontage. While the narrow roadway naturally encourages lower vehicle speeds, the environment lacks formal pedestrian crossings, traffic calming, or dedicated buffers between the walkway and parked vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses built directly to the sidewalk edge. While a paved sidewalk is present, it lacks any buffer from the roadway and is partially obscured by a large parked vehicle.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides, though they lack a buffer from the roadway. The street is constrained by row houses built to the sidewalk edge and parallel parking on one side, which naturally slows traffic but limits pedestrian visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the left side of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and trash receptacles on the right sidewalk reduce the effective walking width.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Install street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lane.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and prevent parking too close to the corner.

result.summary: The image shows a residential sidewalk in fair condition, bordered by row houses and a fenced-off vacant lot. While the walkway is wide and continuous, the environment lacks pedestrian-scale lighting and features some minor maintenance issues like overhanging vegetation and a dilapidated fence.

hazards.name: Dilapidated wooden fence
hazards.description: The wooden fence is broken and has jagged edges, posing a minor injury risk to pedestrians passing closely.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image along the property line

hazards.name: Overhanging vegetation
hazards.description: Vines and branches from the adjacent lot are encroaching on the vertical clearance of the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center, above the fence

interventions.title: Fence Repair or Replacement
interventions.description: Replace the damaged wooden fence with a more durable and aesthetically pleasing boundary to improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Regularly trim overhanging plants to ensure the full width and height of the sidewalk remain clear for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street-level lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety during evening hours.
